incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager - Canary failures detected for inference-runtime service in us-west-2. Error rate spiking to ~15% for canary shard. Deploy ID: deploy/2024-06-15T23:41Z. Affected route: /v1/generate.
Maya (oncall): I'm on it, looking at canary dashboards now.
Sam (SRE): I'm seeing 500s from the new tokenizer-change commit (commit abcdef1). Error pattern: `TokenizerError: unknown token bytes` in logs.
Priya (eng): confirmed, that commit touched tokenizer normalization for long-prefix caching. Rolling back asap if confirmed.
Iris (support): Any customer-facing impact? We have two customers reporting increased latency and errors on streaming endpoints.
Maya (oncall): Customer-impact: partial - streaming requests for medium/long prompts failing ~10-20% for canary traffic only. No global outage yet.
Jamal (PM): Flagging large customers on the affected region, prepping status message if we need to broaden.
Sam (SRE): Quick check of canary routing shows 5% of traffic routed to canary. Errors started ~5m after canary rollout. Logs:```
2024-06-16T04:41:12Z inference-runtime[canary-3]: TokenizerError: unknown token bytes at tokenize.py:78
2024-06-16T04:41:12Z inference-runtime[canary-3]: trace id=tx-9b7c
```
Priya (eng): I can reproduce locally with the same model and long prompt (> 2k tokens). Failing when prefix cache kicks in. I think the normalization change didn't cover a multi-byte sequence edge case.
Maya (oncall): Given customer impact and it's a single commit, can we revert that commit from canary and re-deploy? Prefer not a full rollback if revert is quick.
Priya (eng): Agreed. I'll prepare a quick revert patch. Will do a git revert of abcdef1 and push to canary branch.
Sam (SRE): While Priya prepares revert, I'll flip the feature flag for tokenizer_v2 to off on canary nodes. Command: `curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle -d '{"flag":"tokenizer_v2","env":"canary","state":false}'`
Maya (oncall): Do that now, Sam. That should reduce new failures immediately.
Sam (SRE): Done. Flag toggled to false on canary. Reactions: :white_check_mark:. Error rate dropped to ~2% within 30s.
Priya (eng): Revert ready. Patch churn:```
$ git checkout -b revert/abcdef1
$ git revert --no-commit abcdef1
$ git commit -m "revert: undo tokenizer normalization that causes multi-byte token bug"
$ git push origin revert/abcdef1
$ ./deploy-canary.sh --image inference-runtime:revert-abcdef1
```
Maya (oncall): Proceed with the canary deploy. Keep monitoring latency and 5xx.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: inference-runtime image inference-runtime:revert-abcdef1 -> canary-2024-06-16-0450
Sam (SRE): Watchin' logs. I'll tail canary-3 and canary-4.
Priya (eng): Canary pods report healthy. No tokenizer errors in new logs.
Iris (support): Customer reports are updating — one customer said errors stopped after ~3 minutes.
Sam (SRE): Metrics show error rate back to baseline (~0.3%). Latency unaffected.
Maya (oncall): Great. Priya, after you push revert PR, let's coordinate a small patch release to prod. We should avoid full rollback since it's single commit. Plan: promote revert image to prod canaries and then prod.
Priya (eng): Filing the revert PR and creating a short changelog for release notes. I'll request a canary promote in 15m.
Jamal (PM): I'll draft a short customer note: summary + mitigation + ETA for full prod rollout.
Maya (oncall): Handoff note for next oncall (night): incoming oncall, we had a canary regression due to tokenizer normalization commit abcdef1 causing multi-byte tokenization failures for long prompts. Immediate mitigations: feature flag off for canary, git revert and canary redeploy. Canary healthy and error rates normalized. Prod rollout pending promote window.
Maya (oncall): Next oncall, please monitor the following dashboards: inference-runtime/canary/errors, inference-runtime/prod/errors, and tokenization/logs for any residual stack traces referencing `TokenizerError`.
Sam (SRE): I'll keep a short watch for next 30m and then handover.
Iris (support): I've queued a private status update for affected customers and will update once prod rollout completes.
Priya (eng): Prod deploy scheduled in ~20m assuming canary stays healthy. Deploy steps: promote image `inference-runtime:revert-abcdef1` -> prod-canary -> wait 10m -> full prod.
Maya (oncall): If anything deteriorates during prod canary, immediate kill-switch is flip feature flag to prior tokenizer or run `kubectl scale --replicas=0 deployment/inference-runtime-prod` if we need an emergency stop (but let's avoid).
deploy-bot: Prod canary promotion queued.
Sam (SRE): 30m watch complete — handing off to night oncall @Maya (oncall) -> @next-oncall (placeholder). All metrics stable.
Maya (oncall): Handoff complete. Closing thread here but will reopen if prod issues show up.
Iris (support): Noted, I'll keep support channel updated.
Jamal (PM): Thanks team — good rapid mitigation. Action item for eng: add unit test for multi-byte normalization edge-case.
Priya (eng): Filed GH issue #5789 for test and longer-term fix.
Maya (oncall): End of thread. :white_check_mark:
